transcript.answer: A Record over EscalationTrigger gives the same compile-time guarantee as a switch with no default. If someone adds a member without an entry, `npm run typecheck` fails. A switch that covers every trigger would exceed the lint complexity limit, so the fixture (apps/api/test/fixtures/escalationTriggers.ts) uses a `satisfies Record<EscalationTrigger, ...>` map instead. Typechecking of tests since #275 is what made this possible. FR-003 originally specified the switch.

judgements.reason: The answer states both essential points: the Record gives the same typecheck failure on a missing member, and a full switch would exceed the lint complexity limit; the extra details do not contradict the gold.
